statement: No arithmetic (difference or ratio) between results from different questions or answer formats
why: Different stems and scales measure different things on different bases; the difference has no defined meaning. The retired V1 ledger broke this

statement: The field's level of measurement must reach the method's minimum level
why: Means need equal intervals; ranks need order; shares need only categories

statement: Methods that need a partition (options adding to 100%) only apply to one-answer fields and rating rows
why: Several-answer options are separate yes/no fields; their shares overlap

statement: Methods that need each person's answers cannot use the structured results
why: The structured source holds group tables only; respondent slots are reserved in the schema (ADR-009)

statement: A field answered by fewer than 25 people is not analysed statistically
Tests between groups use only groups that do not overlap
why: Overlapping groups (e.g. decision stages; several-answer screeners) share respondents; tests assume independence

statement: Associations computed across groups describe groups and must say so
Written-answer counts and survey shares are never put on one axis or differenced
why: Different units (answers vs share of people) and different questions; join only by concept in a side-by-side display. The retired V3 felt-vs-said broke this
source: Fetters et al. (2013); Sandelowski et al. (2009); Scott's review 2026-10-30

why: The survey holds no revenue cost or deal-value data

statement: The method must accept the field's answer format
why: A method defined for one format says nothing about another

statement: Two fields compared on one axis must share stem scale and base
why: Same people asked the same way is what makes two shares comparable

statement: Interpretive lenses state no quantity of their own
why: An economic or systems lens explains a measured result; it does not measure

statement: An interpretive lens applies only to the gates it speaks to
why: Search costs belong to Access; transaction costs to Vision and Case; a lens on an unrelated question adds noise not insight

statement: A method tied to one kind of scale applies only to fields on that scale
why: Stated importance cannot be read from a frequency or agreement scale; found at Scott's review when DC02 passed on Q3 and Q8
